scope: Preparation, synthetic tests, published Q1 witness and freeze only until exact GO

R1.S_CONT: Remain open without marks/prices in gap. Resume ordinary executable-side logic, stop first, stop gap at worse available open plus slip. If deadline fell inside gap, TIME at first observed open with market slip before high/low checks.
R1.S_PESS: At each gap exit at original stop with ordinary slip, or first observed executable open if worse than stop. FX mid_open of that first observed minute. Model closed_at equals its minute open.
R1.S_OPT: At each gap exit at original target with no price improvement and no exit slip. FX mid_open of first observed minute. Model closed_at equals its minute open.
R1.caveat: Scenario assumptions, NOT mathematical portfolio bounds; state changes alter later entries/pauses/balance. No interpolated prices or marks.

R2: More than five consecutive missing minutes or end of data during exposure: UNRESOLVED_EXECUTION, total net_eur null, retain known costs. No imputation.
R3: Missing entry quote: append ENTRY_QUOTE_MISSING_REFUSED, refuse without halt or entry/risk quota consumption, continue unchanged signal rules.
unchanged: Actual V03 rearmed signal, incomplete M5 session cancellation, stops/targets/costs/account sizing/4 entry cap/500 planned daily risk/125 planned per entry/24h pause/daily reset all preserved

Q1_witness.comparison: Each corresponding trade and all original numeric fields to tolerance1e-8; timestamps/directions/labels exact; no gap in control exposure; all three scenarios checked
Q1_witness.on_mismatch: STOP, write witness failure report, no freeze or alteration of expected values

bootstrap.calendar: Monday-Friday evaluation dates, zero-trade sessions included
bootstrap.blocks: Mobile non-circular length5, starts uniform in0..N-5 inclusive
bootstrap.blocks_per_draw: floor(N/5)+1, concatenate then truncate to N sessions
bootstrap.R: Realized netEUR / original planned riskEUR, same as frozen runner
bootstrap.descriptive_bound: np.quantile(metrics,0.05,method=linear); unadjusted, does not decide verdict

holm_user_amendment.hypotheses: For each of V03,V04 H0 mean<=0 vs H1 mean>0
holm_user_amendment.sorted_order: Ascending rawp; deterministic V03 first for ties
holm_user_amendment.R2_in_either_strategy: No adjusted p for either strategy; neither can be candidate
holm_user_amendment.interpretation: Exact requested rule; supersedes any confidence-bound decision; not independently validated inference or FTMO probability

verdict_priority_per_strategy: R2 in any of six complete continuous runs => NON CONCLUANT
S_CONT higher_costs evaluation closed count<100 => NON CONCLUANT
Same strategy: S_CONT higher_costs evaluation meanR>=0.05 AND joint Holm adjustedp<0.05 AND S_PESS higher_costs evaluation net>0 => CANDIDAT À COLLECTE PROSPECTIVE
